name: PM · IT team delivery plan & management decisions (from shift 2026-11-18)
description:
Living plan for the IT team board, written by ProjectManager on 2026-11-18 (shift 2). Wake 20 Nov 09:00 to confirm the demo slot and refresh the forecast before M1's demo.

## Increment plan (all dates FORECAST until the owner confirms on the card)

| Milestone | Deliverable | Owner | Date | Deployable | Demoable | Card |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| M1 | One command → platform up → login → workspace list | devops + web_master | 21 Nov | yes | yes | b9aaf03c |
| M2 | One workspace served through Traefik, preview visible in UI | devops + workspace | 25 Nov | yes | yes | 299d12ce |
| M3 | Efforts setting visible in UI, tested, behind a flag | software_developer + qa_automation | 27 Nov | yes | yes | 140668fe |

## Blockers on the critical path (gate before any milestone can be called Done)
1. d1ba037a — declare the pytest suite in `qa_policy`. Wake 19 Nov 08:00. Fixes `tests.no-suite`.
2. 5ee9dbfa — map changed sources to tests. **Sliced by PM on 18 Nov:** A security/ciso+user_management 19–20 Nov · B efforts+smol by 24 Nov (this is M3's Done gate) · C remaining runtime 25–26 Nov. Due 24 Nov.
3. 248d0a54 → fbb93de8 → 25822947 — prove there are no tracked secrets before the uncommitted efforts work is committed. 25822947 set to `onhold` on 18 Nov: it cannot report a result before the scan chain produces one.

## Decisions needed from management
1. **Who signs off the M1 demo, and is Friday 21 Nov 14:00 the slot?** Options: (a) Friday 14:00, recommended; (b) move to a standing weekly Friday. Decide by 20 Nov.
2. **If the repo cannot be inspected from inside the project, re-root the project at `codx-junior-platform`?** Options: (a) yes, recommended — it clears 3 cards at once; (b) grant a shell surface per shift. Decide by 19 Nov 17:00, only if the cheap path in 248d0a54 fails.
3. **Is the efforts feature in this demo cycle?** Options: (a) keep as M3 behind a flag, recommended; (b) defer, end the cycle at M2.

## Next demo
M1 — Friday 21 Nov 14:00: clean host → one command → platform up → login → workspace list → open one workspace. Team needs a demo host and a reproducible `demo/up.sh`; the script is in card b9aaf03c.
